summary: Iteration 2 focused on the reported 'Eye' import compile bug and the image-upload migration to Emergent object storage. Frontend now compiles cleanly and Dashboard renders (verified data-testid='dashboard-title' + empty-state). Image upload end-to-end works: POST /api/upload-image returns /api/files/article-writer/uploads/<uuid>.ext, ArticleEditor inserts full BACKEND_URL markdown, dialog closes, success toast shows, GET on the returned URL returns HTTP 200 with image/png. Backend regression tests (9/9) pass. However, article generation is BROKEN with the current model name.

critical.issue: Returns 500 with LiteLLM/Anthropic error: 'model: claude-4-sonnet-20250514' not found. server.py line 113 uses .with_model('anthropic', 'claude-4-sonnet-20250514'). Correct Anthropic model id for Claude Sonnet 4 is 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514'. This blocks new article creation entirely for users starting from an empty DB.

action_items: Fix Claude model identifier in /app/backend/server.py line 113: change 'claude-4-sonnet-20250514' to 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514' (per Anthropic/LiteLLM naming). Without this fix, POST /api/articles/generate returns 500 and users cannot create articles.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: model id is wrong ('claude-4-sonnet-20250514'). Anthropic uses 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514'.
server.py get_articles: sorting done in-memory after fetching up to 1000 — fine for MVP but consider sorting via Mongo ($sort) with an index on created_at.
server.py get_file: catches all exceptions and maps to 404, which may mask legitimate 500s from storage. Consider distinguishing upstream 404 vs 5xx.
ArticleEditor.jsx: axios sets Content-Type multipart/form-data manually without boundary — works because browsers/FormData override, but idiomatic to omit that header entirely.
Dashboard.jsx: no client-side error boundary; a single bad article payload would break the grid.

success_rate.backend: 100% for tested endpoints (9/9) — generation excluded due to model bug
success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (compile fix, upload, save, export dialog)

seed_data_creation: Seeded a temporary MongoDB article 'TEST-seed-b23a6830' via motor to bypass broken generation for editor UI tests; deleted afterwards via DELETE /api/articles/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The compile-error bug fix ('Eye' import removal + craco sideEffects rule) is verified — Dashboard loads cleanly and empty-state renders. Image upload storage migration to Emergent object storage works: POST /api/upload-image + GET /api/files/{path} both verified (see /app/backend/tests/test_article_writer.py). One critical unresolved bug: article generation still uses wrong Claude model id 'claude-4-sonnet-20250514'; should be 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514'. After main agent fixes, retest generate + full new-article flow.
rca of the issue: COMPILE-ERROR ROOT CAUSE (fixed by main agent): unused 'Eye' import from lucide-react combined with webpack 5.110 lazy-barrel optimization treating lucide-react as sideEffect-free caused the icon to be tree-shaken with an incorrect named export lookup, surfacing as 'export Eye was not found'. Fix removed unused import in Dashboard.jsx and added craco webpack rule setting sideEffects:true for lucide-react in dev. Verified via live Playwright load — no overlay, no page errors, dashboard renders. GENERATION 500 RCA: emergentintegrations passes model group 'claude-4-sonnet-20250514' straight to LiteLLM → Anthropic, which does not recognize this id. Anthropic canonical id is 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514' (order: family-tier-date). Mitigation: update the string in server.py line 113.
